## Purpose
The Logs page's view of the traces this backend exports to Mistral Observability. Nothing is stored locally. Every read goes to Mistral's observability API (`/v1/observability/traces` and `/spans`), filtered to this service and read with the calling workspace's key. It also provides the admin console's "actions by person" search.

## Responsibilities
- **`GET /observability/status`** returns `{enabled, service_name, environment, redaction, endpoint, console_url}`.
- **`GET /observability/traces`** lists traced actions newest first, one row per trace.
  - Query parameters:
    - `kind`: workflow, run, pipeline, http or llm;
    - `workflow`;
    - `status`: error or ok;
    - `q`: text in the root span name;
    - `execution_id`;
    - `hours`: up to 2160, default 24;
    - `page_size`: up to 100, default 50;
    - `cursor`.
  - Builds a search expression joined with `AND`:
    - `service_name = '<OBSERVABILITY_SERVICE_NAME>'`;
    - a `root_span_name LIKE` prefix for the kind (the prefixes are `workflow `, `run `, `pipeline `, the HTTP methods POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, or the LLM prefixes `chat `, `embeddings `, `invoke_agent`, `create_agent`, `text_completion`, `ocr`);
    - `workflow_name = …`;
    - `error_count > 0` or `= 0`;
    - `root_span_name ILIKE '%q%'`;
    - `trace_id = execution_trace_hex(execution_id)`.
  - The time window runs from `now - hours` to `now + 5 min`.
  - Returns `{items: [trace rows], cursor, has_more}`, leaving out private (sign-in and admin) traces.
- **`GET /observability/traces/{trace_id}`** calls `trace_detail`:
  - fetches the trace summary and pages through all spans (up to 2000, 100 per page), sorted by start time;
  - a private root returns 404 "This trace is not available here.";
  - returns `{trace, root, spans, rules (spans whose kind is rule, as rows), rule_counts{pass, fixed, warn, fail}, execution_id, truncated}`.
- **`GET /observability/executions/{execution_id}`** returns the trace for `tracing.execution_trace_hex(execution_id)`.
- **`GET /observability/rules?verdict&rule&workflow&hours&page_size&cursor`** searches spans with `operation_name = 'evaluate'`, filtering on `span_attributes['app.rule.verdict']` and on the rule name (ILIKE).
- **`GET /observability/workflows?hours=720`** returns the workflow names that have traces, using `fetch_options(field_name="workflow_name")`.
- **`search_actions(actor_ref, kind, q, hours, page_size, cursor)`** is not a route; `routes/admin.py` calls it. It searches root spans whose `app.kind` is http, workflow or run (optionally for one `enduser.id`) and returns action rows with `actor_ref`, `workspace_id`, `http_status` and similar fields.

## Key elements
- **`_client()`.** A Mistral reader per key, with a 60 s timeout and at most 64 cached readers. It is never instrumented, so browsing the logs never creates more logs.
- **`_quote`** escapes backslashes and single quotes for the search expression.
- **`_trace_row`, `_span_row` and `_rule_row`** normalise the SDK objects into JSON rows.
  - A span's kind comes from the `app.kind` attribute, or from the operation name: execute_tool → tool, evaluate → rule, chat/embeddings → llm, invoke_agent → agent.
  - Rule rows read the `app.rule.*` attributes, falling back to `gen_ai.evaluation.*`.
- **`_parent_id`** treats an all-zero or empty parent id as None.
- **Private traces.** `_private_name` and `_private_span` match `PRIVATE_PREFIXES` from `observability.http`, or `tracing.PRIVATE_ATTRIBUTE`.
- **`_scrub_attrs`** masks fields with secret-looking names again, including inside a JSON `app.request.body`.
- **`_upstream_error`:**
  - an upstream 404 becomes 404 "Not on Mistral yet — traces arrive a few seconds after the action finishes.";
  - anything else becomes 502 "Mistral observability API: …".
- **`_console_link`** builds `{OBSERVABILITY_CONSOLE_URL}?trace_id=<id>`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
Read-only calls to Mistral.

## Configuration
`OBSERVABILITY_SERVICE_NAME`, `OBSERVABILITY_ENVIRONMENT`, `OBSERVABILITY_REDACT` and `OBSERVABILITY_CONSOLE_URL`.

## Interactions
- Route policy: GET needs logs.view.
- Spans are written by `app/observability/tracing.py` and `http.py`.
- `routes/admin.py` uses `trace_detail(..., hide_private=False)` and `search_actions`.

## Error handling and edge cases
See `_upstream_error` under Key elements.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Old traces may still contain sign-in request bodies.** Sign-in and admin traces are no longer exported, but ones exported earlier can still be on Mistral, so they are filtered out of the Logs page.
- **Mistral serves at most 100 spans per page.**

## How to rebuild this file
The helpers and handlers above, using the Mistral SDK's `beta.observability.traces` and `spans` async methods.
